atlas-connect: name and fix the rare suite flake (~1 run in 15; seen twice on 2026-08-24, never reproduced in 60+ consecutive runs). Leading hypothesis: the API test classes set ATLAS_API_RATE_LIMIT=3 in the PROCESS environment in setUpClass and restore it in tearDownClass, while RateLimiter reads that env var once at server construction — so a server built inside that window inherits a limit of 3 and a class making a 4th request from 127.0.0.1 gets a 429. Reproduction recipe: loop `cd atlas-connect && python3.13 -m unittest discover -s tests` capturing output per run until one reports FAILED, then read the named test. Fix direction (once named): pass per_minute explicitly to the test servers instead of via the shared process env, so no class can change another class's limit.
